analysis.title: PTS Technical Views: Equity Indices
key_insights: S&P 500 has moved below 7,620 for a second time and is testing the 7,492-7,484 support zone. A decisive break below 7,484 would expose the rising 200-day SMA near 7,310, then 7,261. The broader bullish structure holds above 7,310.
Breadth is solid. About 60% of S&P 500 constituents sit above their 200-day and 50-day SMAs, which Pictet reads as a strong short-term breadth thrust and less reliance on mega-cap leadership.

Nasdaq 100 corrected from the 31,452 high into the 27,858-27,941 support cluster, where Fibonacci support meets the rising 200-day SMA near 27,941. A close below the 200-day SMA would expose 27,176-26,182. A recovery above 28,750 would favor a move toward 31,650.

The Nasdaq 100 / S&P 500 ratio broke below the 3.77-3.82 support zone, which shifts focus to 3.59. Pictet describes this as rotation away from technology rather than a broad market breakdown. The ratio must reclaim 3.77-3.82 to re-enter the bullish channel.
S&P 500 Equal Weight cleared its 61.8% Fibonacci level at 8,795 and is testing resistance at 8,889. A close above 8,889 reopens the path to 9,041. Initial support is 8,795-8,704.

The S&P 500 Equal Weight / S&P 500 ratio cleared its 200-day SMA and 1.1563 resistance, opening the way to 1.1709. The longer-term relative trend stays negative below 1.195-1.20, and 1.1563-1.15 must hold.

Russell 2000 is testing the 2,735-2,805 support cluster. A daily close above 2,934 would validate the breakout-retest scenario and support a move toward 3,000-3,070. A weekly close below 2,735 would expose 2,450-2,559.
The Russell 2000 / S&P 500 ratio rebounded from the 0.874-0.899 support area after an oversold RSI extreme. A move above 0.948-0.964 would preserve the path toward 1.0085.
VIX spiked to the 50% Fibonacci resistance near 24.55 and is fading, currently 19.42. Support is 18.26-17.87, and the index could oscillate around its 200-day SMA at 18.26.

S&P 500 long-term view: the secular uptrend is intact after the index reached the 7,459-7,500 breakout objective. A sustained break above 7,743-7,750 points to 8,218-8,747, with 8,800-9,000 as the longer-term target. A weekly break below 7,492 would weaken the fifth-wave count. Bearish RSI divergence points to fading momentum.
S&P 500 / STOXX Europe 600 ratio broke above the 14.00-14.53 resistance area, which now acts as support. This favors continued US outperformance, with the 15.22 all-time high in focus.

Europe is improving but polarised. The SMI broke above 14,669, which puts the 15,200 wave-5 target in focus. The DAX reclaimed its 50-day SMA at 25,574. EURO STOXX 50 is stabilising near its 200-day SMA around 6,107. The CAC 40 is the weakest major index below 8,090-8,217.
DAX is testing the 25,900-26,194 resistance zone. Holding 25,574 keeps scope for 26,194 and then 26,618. A close below 25,574 would shift focus back to the 200-day SMA near 24,879.

CAC 40 failed a breakout from its 8,755 all-time high and is testing 7,581 support, where the channel lower boundary meets the 200-week SMA. A weekly close below 7,581 raises the risk of a move toward 6,764. Above 7,933 a relief rally has traction, with 8,090 and 8,217 next.

Nikkei 225 stabilised above the 61,500-61,840 support cluster, which includes the rising 200-day SMA. It needs to reclaim the 50-day SMA near 65,622 before 69,909 returns to focus. A break above 69,909 would put 79,126 in focus.

Hang Seng is rebounding from oversold conditions above 22,804, but the recovery is tactical below 23,602. Stronger confirmation needs a break above 24,895-25,333. A return below 22,804 would expose 22,518 and then 21,425. The secular downtrend from 2018 remains in place.
risk_factors: A weekly break below 7,492 in the S&P 500 would weaken the wave-5 count and raise the risk of a broader correction.
A close below the Nasdaq 100 200-day SMA near 27,941 would expose 27,176-26,182.
A weekly close below 2,735 in the Russell 2000 would invalidate the breakout retest.
A weekly close below 7,581 in the CAC 40 would raise the risk of a deeper correction toward 6,764.
A weekly close below the DAX 200-day SMA would weaken the continuation case and raise the risk of a deeper consolidation.
A return below 22,804 in the Hang Seng would invalidate the higher-low scenario.
charts_described: S&P 500 daily chart: index below 7,620 for the second time, testing support at 7,492-7,484, with the 200-day SMA at 7,309 as the next focus.
Nasdaq 100 vs S&P 500 daily chart: ratio broke below the 3.77-3.82 support zone, with an all-time high at 4.06 and a wave-5 target at 4.20.
S&P 500 / STOXX Europe 600 weekly chart: ratio broke above the 14.00-14.53 resistance area with the 200-week SMA supporting the trend for 14 years and an all-time high at 15.22.
vol_and_positioning: VIX at 19.42 after a spike to 24.55, the 50% Fibonacci resistance. Support is 18.26-17.87 and the 200-day SMA is at 18.26.
S&P 500 breadth: nearly 60% of constituents above both the 200-day and 50-day SMAs, after an earlier oversold divergence between short- and long-term breadth.
Bearish RSI divergence on the S&P 500 weekly chart and on the Nasdaq 100 long-term chart points to fading momentum and a more volatile advance.

tension_points.bull_case: The Nasdaq 100 is testing its rising 200-day SMA near 27,941, where Fibonacci support and the RSI near oversold suggest a credible stabilisation area. A recovery above 28,750 would favor a move toward 31,650.
tension_points.bear_case: The correction accelerated below 28,750 and the Nasdaq 100 / S&P 500 ratio has lost its relative support. A close below the 200-day SMA would expose 27,176-26,182.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A close below the 200-day SMA near 27,941 would expose 27,176-26,182.

tension_points.bull_case: Holding 7,492-7,484 preserves the lateral consolidation and allows another recovery attempt toward 7,620 and then 7,730-7,845. Breadth near 60% supports a broader advance.
tension_points.bear_case: A second break below 7,620 confirms weaker short-term momentum, and bearish RSI divergence on the weekly chart points to fading momentum.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A decisive break below 7,484 would expose the 200-day SMA near 7,310, and a weekly break below 7,492 would weaken the fifth-wave count.
